description: This file is a shell script that manages downloading, extracting, installing, verifying, and updating software packages (bundles). It defines functions for each step and contains a main execution block that processes a list of bundle versions, handling package metadata, version checks, signature verification, and post-installation steps.

methods.name: downloadApp
methods.description: Downloads an application bundle to the download directory.

methods.name: extractApp
methods.description: Extracts downloaded bundle files and performs sanity checks.

methods.name: installApp
methods.description: Installs the application package contents into the designated directory.

methods.name: searchApp
methods.description: Searches for the application in download and install directories.

methods.name: verifyAppSignature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of the downloaded application.

methods.name: updatePkgStatus
methods.description: Broadcasts the package status to other components.

methods.name: updatePackage
methods.description: Coordinates the download, extraction, installation, signature verification, and post-install validations for a package.
